description: Past USD price of a coin from DefiLlama (keyless, no key): pass a CoinGecko id ("dogecoin") or a common ticker ("DOGE", "BTC", "ETH", "SOL") and a date, and get the spot price on that day. Add `days` for a daily trend series from that date forward. This is NOT the live price — use get_quote or token_info for the current price. Use it for questions like "what was DOGE last month". Result includes `display` markdown: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

coin.description: CoinGecko id or ticker, e.g. "dogecoin" or "DOGE".

date.description: The date as YYYY-MM-DD (or an ISO datetime).

days.description: Days of daily trend from the date forward (0 or omit = just that day).

name: price_history
title: Historical coin price
